key.name: tool-settings
key.summary: The colour and line width each drawing tool last had
key.description: Written by the screenshot tools as they are used, so that each drawing tool comes back with the colour and width it was left with.

key.name: capture-thumbnail
key.description: After a capture from the screenshot bar, a thumbnail rests at the bottom right for six seconds, with Edit, Copy, Pin on top, Show in Files and Delete, in place of GNOME's notification. Off, GNOME's notification comes back.

key.name: capture-pin
key.description: A capture can be pinned above every window, from the thumbnail or from the Pin button in the screenshot bar (Ctrl+P). Off, there is no Pin, and pinned pictures let go.
